name: Booking Form
description: Booking and reservation form where a customer chooses a date and time, picks a service, enters the number of guests or people, adds contact details and notes, and submits a booking request. Use it whenever a business takes appointments or reservations: salon and spa visits, doctor and dental appointments, restaurant table reservations, consultations, classes, tutoring sessions, studio shoots, repair visits and site visits. Choose this when the visitor must pick a time. For a general message use contact-form; for ordering items use order-request-form.
userPhrases: customers should be able to book

notFor.reason: General message with no date or time choice.
Ordering specific items with quantities, not booking a time.
Only the date and time slot chooser, without the full form.

name: Portfolio Grid
description: Portfolio grid of past projects with images, titles and category filters. Use it to show previous work, completed jobs, client projects and creative samples as proof of quality for photographers, designers, architects, interior decorators, builders, agencies, wedding and event planners, freelancers and craftspeople. Each card stands for one project or piece of work. For a plain photo album use image-gallery; for one project explained in depth use case-study-detail.
userPhrases: samples of what we have done

notFor.reason: Photos only, with no project titles or categories of work.
One project told in depth, not a grid of many.

name: Menu & Product Catalog Grid
description: Menu and catalogue grid that lists food, drinks or simple products by category with names, photos, descriptions, prices, dietary tags and order or enquiry buttons. Use it for restaurant, cafe, bakery and takeaway menus, cake and sweets lists, catering packages and any price list of edible or simple retail items. It displays items only; there is no shopping cart or online checkout. For image-led retail goods such as candles, clothing or crafts use product-card-grid.

notFor.reason: Image-led retail goods that are not food or drink.
Services with durations, not dishes.
Subscription or package tiers, not a menu.

name: Hero Banner
description: Hero banner at the very top of the home page: large headline, short value proposition, primary and secondary call-to-action buttons, background image and intro badge. Use it on every home page and landing page to show in one glance what the business does and what the visitor should do next, such as Book now, Order today or Get a quote. For inner pages use page-header instead.

notFor.reason: Secondary pages, not the home page.
A closing conversion strip, not the first screen.

name: About Us
description: About section that tells the story of the business or person: background, founder story, mission, values, history and a few highlight figures, with a photo. Use it for About pages and home-page introductions where visitors want to know who is behind the business and why to trust it, on any small business, clinic, studio, school, restaurant, agency or freelancer site. For a dated history use timeline; for staff profiles use team-grid.

notFor.reason: Dated milestones rather than a narrative.
Several people with roles, not one story.
What is offered, not who offers it.

name: Contact Form
description: Contact form for general enquiries: the visitor enters name, email, phone, subject and message, with the business address and contact details beside it. Use it on Contact pages and wherever a visitor should send a message, ask a question, request a quote that has no item list, give feedback or ask for a call back. For choosing a time use booking-form; for ordering specific items use order-request-form; for showing details with no form use contact-info-block.
userPhrases: people can send me a message

notFor.reason: Shows phone and address without a form.
Picks a date and time.
Selects items with quantities and a delivery date.
Collects only an email address for updates.

name: Image Gallery
description: Photo gallery grid with category filter tabs and a lightbox that opens each picture full size. Use it for photo albums, event pictures, food photography, interior and venue photos, product shots and completed work photos on any website where many pictures should be browsed together: weddings, restaurants, salons, gyms, studios, hotels. For a slideshow showing one picture at a time use gallery-carousel; for projects with titles use portfolio-grid.

notFor.reason: Slideshow, one image at a time.
Projects with titles and categories.
Two matching images compared.

name: Pricing Table
description: Tiered pricing table that compares plans side by side, with a monthly and yearly toggle, a feature checklist per plan, a highlighted popular plan and a button for each plan. Use it for gym and club memberships, coaching and tutoring packages, subscription services, maintenance contracts and bundle packages with Basic, Standard and Premium levels. It does not take payment; plan buttons lead to contact or booking. For a plain list of services with prices use services-price-list.

notFor.reason: An itemised list with one price per service, not tiers.
Food items, not plans.

name: Testimonials
description: Testimonials section showing customer reviews, quotes, star ratings, names and photos. Use it to build trust on any business site: restaurants, salons, clinics, tutors, gyms, photographers, agencies and sellers. Typical phrases are customer reviews, client feedback, what people say about us, ratings and success stories. It shows reviews supplied by the owner; visitors cannot submit reviews here. For partner logos use logo-cloud; for numbers use stats-counter.

notFor.reason: Logos of partners, not quotes.
Numbers, not written reviews.

name: FAQ Accordion
description: FAQ accordion with collapsible questions and answers. Use it to answer common questions before customers call: pricing, delivery, cancellation policy, how booking works, what to bring, insurance, return policy and arrangements. Fits clinics, salons, schools, shops, restaurants and any service business. Also works as a simple help section with a link to contact.
userPhrases: people keep asking the same things

notFor.reason: A numbered flow, not separate questions.

name: Navbar
description: Top navigation bar with logo or business name, menu links, a call-to-action button, sticky behaviour and a hamburger drawer on mobile. Included on every page as the main header navigation, giving links to Home, About, Services, Gallery, Contact and other pages. Almost every website needs exactly one navbar.

notFor.reason: Bottom of the page, not the top.
A food menu is a different thing from a navigation menu.

name: Footer
description: Site footer at the bottom of every page: brand summary, copyright line, social media icons, grouped navigation links and an email newsletter signup box. Use it on every website to close the page and repeat key links such as contact, privacy policy and social profiles.

notFor.reason: Top of the page, not the bottom.
A dedicated contact section, not the page footer.

name: Features & Services Grid
description: Grid of cards with icon, title and short description that presents what the business offers: services, treatments, specialities, product features, benefits or reasons to choose us. Use it for a services overview where prices are not the focus: dental treatments, tutoring subjects, repair services, consulting areas, gym classes, event services. For services with prices and durations use services-price-list; for a step-by-step flow use process-steps.

notFor.reason: Services with prices and durations.
Ordered steps, not a set of offers.
Food and drink items.

name: Call to Action (CTA) Banner
description: Call-to-action banner with a strong headline, supporting line, main action button, secondary link and accent background, usually placed before the footer or between sections. Use it to push one next step such as Book a visit, Request a quote, Order now or Call us. Fits any business site as a closing conversion section.
userPhrases: a strong button asking people to act

notFor.reason: First screen of the home page.

name: Team & Staff Grid
description: Team grid with photo, name, role, qualifications, short biography, specialities and contact links for each person. Use it to introduce doctors, dentists, specialists, trainers, coaches, teachers, instructors, stylists, chefs, lawyers, consultants or founders. Matches requests like our doctors, meet the team, our staff and our trainers. For one founder story use about-us.

notFor.reason: One story, not a list of people.

name: Stats & Metrics Counter
description: Statistics counter showing large figures such as years of experience, happy customers, patients treated, projects completed, students taught or satisfaction rate. Use it to prove credibility with numbers on home or about pages. For written reviews use testimonials.
userPhrases: show how many customers we have served

notFor.reason: Written opinions, not figures.
Dated events, not totals.

name: Process / How It Works
description: Step-by-step process section with numbered cards explaining how the service works, from first contact or booking to the final result. Use it for how it works, our process, how to order, what to expect at your first visit, treatment journey or project stages. Fits clinics, agencies, builders, caterers, tutors and custom order businesses.

notFor.reason: Separate questions rather than a sequence.
Dated history, not a service flow.

name: Logo Cloud & Accreditations
description: Logo cloud strip of partner, client, brand, accreditation and certification logos or badges. Use it to show trusted by, our partners, as seen in, licences, memberships, awards and certifications that give credibility, for clinics, schools, agencies, contractors and suppliers. Needs logo images from the owner.

notFor.reason: Quotes from people, not logos.

name: Order Request Form
description: Order request form for businesses that take orders without online payment: the customer chooses one or more items from a list, sets a quantity for each, picks a required delivery or pickup date, adds a note and contact details (name, phone, optional email), then sees a summary and a success message. Use it for cake and bakery orders, custom food and catering orders, handmade goods, flowers, gifts, print jobs and quote requests that involve specific items. No payment is taken. For a request with no items use contact-form.
userPhrases: customers send me an order with a delivery date

notFor.reason: A message with no item list.
A time slot, not goods.
Shows products; does not collect an order.

name: Location & Interactive Map
description: Location section with the business address, an embedded map and a Get directions button. Use it for any business with a physical place customers visit: shops, cafes, restaurants, clinics, salons, gyms, offices, studios and event venues. Matches where to find us, our address, how to reach us, directions and find us on the map. If no map link is provided it shows the address only.

notFor.reason: Text contact details without a map.

name: Business Hours & Schedule
description: Weekly business hours table that marks each day open or closed, highlights today, supports lunch breaks and shows a live Open now or Closed badge based on the visitor's local time. Use it for opening times, working hours, clinic timings, store hours and visiting hours. Fits restaurants, shops, clinics, salons, gyms and schools.

notFor.reason: One-off dated events, not weekly hours.
Bookable slots, not a display of hours.

name: Contact Information Block
description: Contact details block listing phone with a tap-to-call link, email with a mailto link, address and social links with icons, without any form. Use it where visitors just need numbers and addresses: contact pages, sidebars and headers. Matches contact details, call us, phone number, email address and reach us. Rows with no value are hidden. For a message form use contact-form.
userPhrases: show our phone number and email
just our contact details, no form

notFor.reason: Has a form to send a message.
Shows a map and directions.

name: WhatsApp Chat Button
description: Floating WhatsApp button fixed to a screen corner that opens a chat with the business number, optionally with a prefilled message. Use it where customers prefer to message instead of filling forms: ordering by WhatsApp, asking prices, quick enquiries and support, common for bakeries, shops, home businesses, salons and clinics. Appears on every page and does not render without a number. It is a chat link, not an AI chatbot or live-chat system.

notFor.reason: A web form, not a chat link.
A profile link in a row of icons, not a floating chat launcher.

name: Product Card Grid
description: Product card grid of image-led cards with name, price, short description, optional badge and an Enquire or similar button. Use it to display goods in a retail or home business: candles, clothing, jewellery, crafts, cosmetics, gifts, furniture, electronics. It is a showcase, not a store: no cart, no checkout and no payment. For food and drink menus use menu-catalog-grid; for a single product page use product-detail.

notFor.reason: Food and drink, listed by category.
One product in depth.

name: Gallery Carousel Slider
description: Image carousel and slideshow that shows one picture at a time with previous and next arrows, dots, touch swipe, keyboard control and optional autoplay that pauses on hover and respects reduced-motion settings. Use it for featured photos, studio shots, venue highlights and compact image showcases. For browsing many photos in a grid use image-gallery.

notFor.reason: A grid for browsing many photos with a lightbox.

name: Newsletter Signup
description: Newsletter signup form with an email field, consent line, validation and a thank-you state. Use it to collect email addresses for mailing lists, updates, offers, news and announcements on any site. Collected addresses are stored for the owner. For a popup version use lead-capture-popup.

notFor.reason: A popup with an offer, not an inline form.
A message form, not a list signup.

name: Inner Page Header Banner
description: Inner-page header with page title, subtitle, breadcrumb trail and optional background image. Use it at the top of secondary pages such as About, Services, Gallery, Menu, Blog and Contact. Not for the home page; use hero-banner there.
userPhrases: a title at the top of each page

notFor.reason: The home page's first screen.

name: Social Links Bar
description: Row of social media icon links built from handles or URLs for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn and WhatsApp; platforms without a value are hidden. Use it to point visitors to the business profiles: follow us, find us on Instagram, our social media. Fits almost any small business, especially photographers, bakeries and salons. For full contact details use contact-info-block.

notFor.reason: Phone, email and address, not only social profiles.
A floating chat launcher.

name: Blog Posts & Articles Grid
description: Blog listing of posts as a grid or list with title, date, author, excerpt, image and optional category filter. Use it for blog, news, articles, updates, tips, recipes, announcements and journal pages that keep the site fresh and help customers find the business. Posts are stored in the database and open in blog-post.

notFor.reason: A single article, not the listing.
Dated happenings, not articles.

name: Blog Article Post
description: Single article layout with title, date, author, hero image, body text and a share row. Use it for each individual blog post, news item, recipe, tutorial or announcement page; it pairs with blog-list.
userPhrases: a page for each blog post

notFor.reason: The listing of many posts.

name: Events & Workshops Schedule
description: Upcoming events list with date badge, time, place and optional link; past events can be hidden or greyed out. Use it for workshops, classes, open days, launches, tastings, live music, community events, exhibitions and seminars. It lists events; it is not a live countdown timer or a ticket-sales system.

notFor.reason: Weekly hours, not one-off events.
History in the past, not upcoming dates.

name: Services & Price Menu
description: Itemised list of services with a price or starting-from price, a short note and an optional duration. Use it for price lists and rate cards: salon and spa treatments, dental and clinic services, repairs, tutoring rates, cleaning, photography packages and consultation fees. Matches our services and prices, rate list and treatment menu. This is a plain list, not tiered subscription plans; for plans use pricing-table.

notFor.reason: Tiered plans compared side by side.
Services without prices.
Food and drink.

name: Before & After Comparison Slider
description: Before and after comparison slider with a draggable divider between two images, operable by touch and keyboard. Use it to show transformations and results: hair and makeup, dental and skin treatments, renovations, cleaning, painting, landscaping, fitness progress and photo retouching.
userPhrases: results of our work side by side

notFor.reason: Many photos, not a pair compared.

name: Video Showcase & Spotlight
description: Embedded video section for a YouTube or Vimeo link that loads when clicked, with a thumbnail and caption. Use it for promo videos, introductions, behind the scenes, tutorials, video testimonials and a recorded walkthrough of a venue or tour. Needs a video link from the owner; it plays a recorded video, not a live stream.

notFor.reason: Still images, not video.

name: Milestones & History Timeline
description: Vertical timeline of dated milestones for company history, founding story, achievements and roadmap. Use it on About pages: our journey, since the founding year, milestones. For one person's career use resume-skills.

notFor.reason: A person's career, not a company history.
A service flow, not dated history.

name: Skills & Experience Resume
description: Resume layout with skills shown with text-labelled levels, work experience and education lists. Use it for personal portfolio and freelancer sites where a person shows a CV: developers, designers, photographers, writers and consultants. Matches resume, CV, skills, experience and education.

notFor.reason: A company's history, not one person's CV.
Several people, not one.

name: Case Study & Project Showcase
description: Detail layout for one portfolio project: title, summary, role, gallery, challenge, solution and result. Use it for an in-depth project story reached from a portfolio card: design projects, building projects, campaigns, events and client work.

notFor.reason: A grid of many projects.

name: Product Detail & Variant Selector
description: Detail layout for one product: large image with thumbnails, name, price, description, a variant selector (size, flavour, colour) and an Enquire button. No cart. Use it for single product pages reached from a product grid, or for items needing choices such as a custom cake flavour or a clothing size.
userPhrases: choose size or flavour then enquire

notFor.reason: Many products at a glance.

name: Search & Filter Bar
description: Search box with debounced typing and category filter chips that narrows a list passed to it. Use it above long lists such as menus, products, blog posts, services, FAQs and events, when there are many items to browse.

notFor.reason: Shows items; the bar only filters them.

name: Appointment Slot & Availability Picker
description: Date picker with selectable time slots from availability data, with a selected state. Use it inside booking flows when visitors must choose from open times: consultations, haircuts, clinic visits, classes and tutoring sessions. Needs availability data from the business. For the complete booking form with contact details use booking-form.
userPhrases: let customers pick a free time

notFor.reason: The full form with contact details.

name: Top Announcement Bar
description: Thin banner above the navigation for short announcements with an optional link and a dismiss button remembered for the session. Use it for sales, offers, holiday closures, new openings, Eid timings, delivery notices and event reminders.
userPhrases: a notice at the top about our sale

notFor.reason: A section inside the page, not a thin top strip.

name: Lead Capture & Discount Modal
description: Modal popup offering a discount or free guide in exchange for an email, opening after a delay or on exit intent once per session, with a focus trap and Escape to close. Use it only when the owner wants more subscribers or a welcome discount. It interrupts visitors, so add it only when asked.
userPhrases: ask for email before they leave

notFor.reason: An inline form, not a popup.

name: Alternating Image & Text Rows
description: Alternating image and text rows that stack into one column on mobile, with optional bullet checklists, badges and buttons. Use it to explain services, story sections, product benefits and features with photos, when about-us or features-grid is too small for the content.
userPhrases: sections with a photo and text side by side

notFor.reason: Short cards, not long image-led rows.
One story block.

name: Cookie Consent & Privacy Notice
description: Cookie notice: a short privacy message with an accept button, remembered in the browser's local storage. Use it for sites that need cookie consent or a GDPR-style notice, typically added site-wide when visitors come from regions that require consent.

notFor.reason: The full policy text, not the banner.

name: Back To Top Button
description: Floating back-to-top button that appears after scrolling and scrolls smoothly to the top, respecting reduced-motion settings. Use it on long pages such as long menus, galleries, blogs and one-page sites.
userPhrases: a button to go back up on long pages

notFor.reason: A chat launcher, not scrolling.

name: Privacy Policy & Terms Layout
feature: Privacy policy and terms of service
description: Layout for privacy policy, terms of service and similar legal text, with numbered clauses, section anchors and contact details; the text is supplied by the owner. Use it for privacy policy, terms and conditions, refund, delivery and return policies, and disclaimers.

notFor.reason: A small banner, not a full page.
